result.summary:
I rebuilt the replay evidence on a single frozen harness. On that harness the fix-1 and fix-2 data differ only in the off-pavement counts (offpave.mask 412,453 -> 402,809 frames). Every bridge, overlap and clearance result is identical, so R5.1.5 (UAL917 / G4 hit.eng and the B19 clear.stand pair) was a harness change and is withdrawn. P10_ACCEPTED stays off, decided on same-harness data. The decision held on the older code and on the shipping code; only the reason changed. All four minors are fixed except the rest-pose one, which is partly done (its app-side half belongs to the bridges track).

- **MAJOR, evidence and P10:** I froze tools/live (invariants.mjs 2f6c5d9b = HEAD 47af104) and ran all-hours replays of the fix-1, final, P10-on and round-5 data on it. A second P10 off/on pair ran on HEAD 47af104 code (the code that ships).
  - On the older frozen code, P10 on removes 96 at-rest bridge-hit frames. It adds 213 aircraft-overlap frames, a new cab contact and 408 orphan frames: collision frames go from 2,970 to 3,162.
  - On the shipping code, no collision class changes at all; only orphan and lag frames grow.
  - Under the owner's collisions-first rule it stays off. The P10 comment, the v7 row and R5.2.1 / R5.2.2 are corrected in place, and R5.1.5 is withdrawn.
- **ARFF:** the striped tan bays were not soil-coloured, as the earlier text said. They failed the texture test, and the white station roof diluted their 25 m window. A new forecourt rule in `paint_pave_naip.py` paves them: +371 m2 at Rescue 41 and nowhere else. A variant without the building condition would also have paved dusty verge at OPS15, so I rejected it. Unpaved ground in the R41 disc fell from 482 to 101 m2, and the 426 m2 strip is now paved.
- **P8:** each added type is now tested against every type the neighbour accepts, needing the larger code's ICAO clearance, capped at the listed dominating type's distance. The verifier's 4 tighter-than-listed pairs drop to 0. C11 no longer lists B736 and F20 no longer lists E75L.
  - F19 and F20 now carry `stop_open` evidence (tagged inferred, not applied). F19's B777 stop is about 12 m aft of the drawn stop (one aircraft), so the drawn pose is tighter than observed and the v6 text is corrected.
  - F20's two B752 stays stopped about 13.9 m beyond the drawn stop. That one goes to the owner.
- **Landside:** the core-colour test now only flags a band. A rejected run is kept when its footprint is at most 15 % soil-coloured, and `w_src` names every rejection. Both of the verifier's pieces are drawn again, 338 pieces in all, with none at 15 % or more.

result.summary:
Close-out round 5, realtime track, fix round 1: both majors are fixed and verified on one harness copy with the live plan cadence.

Harness: tools/live/invariants.mjs (e52f3dfd) adds --plan-cadence live|replay, default live. Each 60-s plan poll carries fetched_at = max(the snapshot's fetch, the last 10-min tick), as the relay serves it.

v2: the far 400-m bridge-ahead retraction now needs SFO's actual block-out. 'alloc', aEv and 'window' count only on lead-in close, and the round-3 two-signal veto stays. False 'arrival gone' re-docks at occupants that stay went to 0 on D (2), A-w (4) and G6 (4). bridge-ahead fell 33 -> 9, 19 -> 3 and 5 -> 0, and every remaining one was followed by the arrival driving in.

v11: standRealloc now fires only on another aircraft's arrival with an actual block-in at that stand more than 10 min after the occupant was last heard. False 'realloc' removals on A-w went 4 -> 0. Offline over all of segment A, same-stand removals went 9 -> 1, and that 1 is a proven tow.

Minors:
- Lock churn: an invalid lock is kept when releasing it would change nothing, and the conflict is logged once. D physUnlocks 278,960 -> 7.
- 2-2A: the root cause was the remote-stand 40-m disc, not a silent dock. A lateral limit fixes it: D gate_far 127,643/2 -> 28/1.
- Repositioned parking: this exposed a second defect, pushed aircraft that went silent being dropped after 75 s. On A-w before, 18 of 22 such drops were heard again at the same place. They are now kept parked.
- No-push re-undock: one re-signal per cancel on a squawk or callsign change. AAL402 lag 424 -> 199 frames.

Trade-offs: bridge.orphan D +1,333 frames / +13 keys and A-w +643 / +3; small first-contact rises in overlap.gnd and clear.taxi; repos side effects (ASA503 offpave at a mask gap, CFJNX 5 building frames).

Requests and hand-offs: C5.1 integration ring 82 / Garage A provenance; C5.2 owner decision on the opt-in --record-sfo-gates flag (not enabled, relay not restarted); C5.3 static pavement gap; C5.4 lead commit. v10 goes to the runtime-minors track.

The 'Round 5 (residuals)' section is appended to docs/requests/realtime_closeout.md. The final code is already in the lead's WIP commit 2b323d9; I made no commits, and no jobs of mine are running.
